backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister actor with no defined methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a change to show a text-only message on Yes click and listing affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files including App.tsx behavior and theme styling.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS variables and theming for light/dark modes using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up the root div and loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main interactive Valentine UI with moving No button and text-only Yes result view.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, identity persistence, and auth client behavior.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles with OKLCH theme variables, typography, and fade-in animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React root initialization wrapping App with InternetIdentity and React Query providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radius, fonts, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Defines the current project state for a Valentine-themed interactive web page, listing existing features, new requests, and architectural notes. Tracks versioning, requirements, and behavior such as the evasive No button and the post-Yes text message.
